recipes.title: Chicken Tikka Masala with Turmeric Rice

items.i: high-protein or natural Greek yogurt (130 g)

steps: Mix the chicken with the grated garlic, ginger, Kashmiri chilli, turmeric, garam masala, Greek yogurt, lemon juice, salt and pepper.
Heat the peanut oil in a large pan over high heat and sear the chicken in two batches, about 5 minutes each, until golden and lightly charred but not cooked through. Set aside.
Melt the ghee in a large pot over medium-high heat and fry the onion and bell pepper with a pinch of salt for 5–6 minutes until soft. Add the garlic and ginger for 1 minute.
Add the cumin seeds, garam masala, Kashmiri chilli, paprika and ground coriander and cook 30–45 seconds.
Stir in the tomato paste, turn to medium and cook 3–4 minutes to bring out its oils and depth.

Turn up to medium-high, return the chicken and juices, stir in the Greek yogurt and bring to a light simmer (about 2 minutes). Add the stock and a pinch of salt, bring to a boil, then simmer uncovered on low for 25–30 minutes until the chicken is tender and the gravy thick.
Bring the rice, stock, turmeric and a pinch of salt to a boil, cover and cook on low for 12 minutes, rest 4 minutes off the heat, then fluff in the 5 g coriander.
Stir the cream and remaining coriander into the curry and cook 2 more minutes; adjust seasoning.
Divide into 5 containers (about 200 g rice and 350 g curry each). Keeps 3 days in the fridge or 4 months frozen; reheat in a pan with a splash of stock.
recipes.notes: Amounts are from the creator's description; per-container nutrition (687 cal, 57 g protein, 71 g carbs, 23 g fat, 4 g fibre, 10 g sugar) is from his card. Use less cream to lighten it.
